sources.scope: 2024 national estimate 141584, prior 2022 estimate 159697; survey every two years, 739 sampled localities. Government notes estimated change is not statistically significant.

sources.publisher: Miaoli County Animal Protection and Health Inspection Office
sources.scope: Miaoli reports about 7400 dogs from the 2025 population survey and persistent local abandonment, free roaming and reproduction pressures.
Systematic review of 26 studies; sampling, variable detection probability, individual identification and population closure can bias abundance estimates.

Shoushan study uses camera traps and population modelling: greater than 75 percent female sterilization could theoretically control abundance without immigration, but 50-100 incoming dogs per year undermine the modelled effect. Not a nationwide treatment trial.
Provider guide documents Talea web/app recording and survey download. FAQ says individual animal photos are NOT recorded within a sighting. No locally replicated field or population estimator test.
2026 community dog population management program describes hotspot and female-source control, owner responsibility and community management. Program intent does not establish outcome effectiveness.
